title: Wood structural panel shear walls.
officialText:
Wood structural panel shear walls shall be designed and constructed in
accordance with AF&PA SDPWS. Wood structural panel shear walls are permitted to resist horizontal forces using
the allowable capacities set forth in Table 2306.3 Allowable capacities in Table 2306.3 are permitted to be increased 40
percent for wind design.
